text.p: TransTechnology Corp said Friday it has completed the acquisition of TCR Corp for $32.6 million, plus other consideration.

The acquisition, said the company, was funded using its existing acquisition line of credit and a new $20 million term facility provided by its current bank lending group. TransTechnology said again that it expects TCR will be additive to earnings in the first quarter of fiscal 1998, which began April 1.
TransTechnology Corp is a maker of specialty fasteners and helicopter rescue hoists and cargo hooks.

TCR produces externally threaded specialty fasteners and similar products for the automotive, heavy vehicle, marine and industrial markets. TCR employs 175 people and reported sales of $23 million for 1996.
